descriptor.name: Pasto urban cadastral parcels (IGAC 2021 base)
descriptor.scope: Urban cadastral base for the municipality of Pasto, within the urban perimeter approved by the applicable POT. Layer description states IGAC open data obtained in 2021; rural parcels are separate layers.
descriptor.attribution: Instituto Geográfico Agustín Codazzi - IGAC; Alcaldía de Pasto Geoportal

evidence: https://geoportal.pasto.gov.co/server/rest/services/Planeacion/Mapa_base_registro_de_descargas/MapServer/29: first-party description identifies the cadastral base on urban land within the municipality and the urban perimeter approved by the POT; IGAC open data obtained in 2021. See evidence/official-layer-metadata.json.

https://geoportal.pasto.gov.co/server/rest/services/Planeacion/Mapa_base_registro_de_descargas/MapServer: first-party serviceDescription is Mapa base del municipio de Pasto, and layer 29 is Predios urbanos. This establishes purpose and municipality scope, without claiming citywide completeness. See evidence/official-service-metadata.json.
